files.rationale: Kept PR A's version that includes ../register_id.circom and instantiates REGISTER_ID, matching the template defined in register_id/register_id.circom and all sibling register_id instances, whereas PR B's REGISTER/register.circom reference does not exist in that directory.
Both sides only trimmed trailing whitespace in the conflicting lines, so PR A's intentional reduction of parallel circom jobs from 5 to 2 is kept along with the shared register_id additions.
Both sides contain the same refactor to the shared constants helpers and try/catch logging; PR A's prettier-formatted version is kept since the differences are only formatting.
Both sides added the same deployment readme; PR A's formatted version is kept because it also fixes the missing 'yarn' prefix on deploy:registry:idcard and the mismatched code fence.

Both sides added the same helper module; PR A's prettier-formatted version is kept, including its EU_ID_CARD registry name DeployIdCardRegistryModule#IdentityRegistry which matches the future id produced by deployIdCardRegistry.ts and the prod deployed_addresses.json.
Both sides made the same rewrite to use the shared constants with a setHubV2 toggle; PR A's prettier-formatted version is kept as the logic is identical.
Both sides made the same rewrite with per-category toggles and log helpers; PR A's prettier-formatted version is kept since the remaining differences are formatting only.
